summary: Squire asks before it finishes the Cloudflare set-up over something the owner's account pays for, naming each paid item with its price, reads every page of the account's subscriptions and keeps only a token that reads back as deploy-only; Squire Update still stages a signed update while Squire reports a problem, warns before installing it and never says an update passed checks it did not; a handover note carries what its job took in across /clear; a new file Claude Code itself loads from the owner's folder is asked first, naming the file; brew and pip3 are asked like any program; and a site's folder changed after the owner's yes is not put live.
title: Paid items kept only on the owner's yes, updates while Squire reports a problem, and files Claude Code loads asked first
